beats.label: S1 · Roger vanishes
beats.text: Lyra's best friend Roger is stolen by the mysterious 'Gobblers'; the Master of Jordan College secretly gives her a truth-reading alethiometer and sends her to London with Mrs Coulter.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the through-line: the alethiometer she still carries, and the friend whose death drives her later.

beats.label: S1 · Coulter is the enemy
beats.text: Lyra discovers Mrs Coulter runs the Gobblers herself and flees; the Gyptians take her in and reveal Coulter is her mother, Lord Asriel her father.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the parents whose choices power the next two seasons and the alliance that gets her north.

beats.label: S1 · North with the bear and the aeronaut
beats.text: Sailing north to rescue the children, Lyra recruits the disgraced armoured bear Iorek Byrnison and Texan aeronaut Lee Scoresby to her cause.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the two allies who both matter across later seasons.

beats.label: S1 · Bolvangar
beats.text: At the Gobblers' base she finds Roger and learns they sever children from their daemons; she destroys the facility and escapes with the alethiometer intact.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names Dust and intercision, the twin obsessions the whole series turns on.

beats.label: S1 · Iorek reclaims Svalbard
beats.text: Captured by the armoured bears, Lyra tricks their usurper king into single combat with Iorek, who kills him and takes the throne, freeing her to reach Asriel.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Iorek is now bear king rather than exile — the standing he holds when Will meets him later.

beats.label: S1 · Asriel kills Roger
beats.text: Reunited on Svalbard, Asriel sacrifices Roger to tear open a bridge into another world and departs to wage war on the Authority itself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The rupture between worlds and the death that will haunt Lyra into the Land of the Dead.

beats.label: S1 · Two children cross over
beats.text: Convinced Dust is not the source of sin, Lyra crosses the bridge alone; in a parallel Oxford, a fugitive boy called Will Parry stumbles through his own portal.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Delivers both protagonists to the same place for season 2 to open on their meeting.

cliffhanger.text: Lyra has walked out of her own world clutching the alethiometer, chasing a father who has just torn a hole in the sky to fight God. A boy from a third world has fallen through his own portal, and her mother is still hunting her.
questions: What lies on the other side of the bridge Asriel opened?
Who is Will Parry, and how will his path cross Lyra's?
What will Coulter do now that Lyra has slipped beyond her reach?

characters.name: Lyra Belacqua
characters.line: Eleven-year-old ward of Jordan College who can read the alethiometer intuitively; she has just crossed the bridge into an unknown world with her daemon Pantalaimon.

characters.name: Will Parry
characters.line: Teenager from a parallel Oxford, on the run after killing an intruder in self-defence, carrying his missing father's letters when he stumbles through a portal.
characters.note: Just arrived in the same city as Lyra without knowing it.

characters.name: Lord Asriel
characters.line: Lyra's estranged father, a heretical polar explorer who sacrificed Roger to open a bridge between worlds and has crossed over to make war on the Authority.

characters.name: Mrs Marisa Coulter
characters.line: Lyra's charming, ruthless mother, the deposed head of the child-severing Gobblers, still intent on controlling her daughter and the prophecy around her.

characters.name: Roger Parslow
characters.line: Lyra's kitchen-boy best friend from Jordan College, killed by Asriel to power the bridge between worlds.

characters.name: Iorek Byrnison
characters.line: Armoured bear who recovered his armour with Lyra's help and killed the usurper Iofur Raknison to become rightful king of Svalbard.

characters.name: Lee Scoresby
characters.line: Texan aeronaut and Iorek's oldest friend; last seen crash-landed with Serafina after searching for the fallen Lyra.

characters.name: Serafina Pekkala
characters.line: Queen of a witch clan and Farder Coram's old lover; allied with the Gyptians and now aware of Lyra's role in a coming war.

characters.name: Lord Boreal
characters.line: Magisterium priest who secretly slips between worlds, currently hunting the vanished explorer Stanislaus Grumman in Will's Oxford.

beats.label: S2 · The city between worlds
beats.text: Lyra emerges in Cittàgazze, an abandoned city where soul-eating spectres hunt adults, and meets Will, a fugitive from the other Oxford.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts the two protagonists in the same room and names the spectres that shape every fight afterwards.

beats.label: S2 · Dust and the alethiometer
beats.text: The alethiometer sends Lyra to Oxford physicist Mary Malone, whose Dark Matter work is secretly the same as Dust research; Boreal steals the alethiometer to leverage Lyra.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Mary, the outside-world scholar who becomes central next season.

beats.label: S2 · Will claims the Subtle Knife
beats.text: The price for the alethiometer is a knife hidden in a Cittàgazze tower; Will wins it in a fight but loses two fingers, becoming its bearer.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Knife and Will's maiming define his identity from here on.

beats.label: S2 · Windows between worlds
beats.text: The Knife cuts openings into any world; Will retrieves the alethiometer from Boreal's house and Lyra meets her mother face-to-face for the first time.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the Knife's real power and forces Lyra and Coulter into direct contact.

beats.label: S2 · The second Eve
beats.text: Coulter tortures a witch and learns Lyra is prophesied as the new Eve who will bring a second Fall; she poisons Boreal and hunts Lyra herself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The prophecy that drives every faction's plan in season 3.

beats.label: S2 · Will meets his father
beats.text: Lee ferries a shaman to Cittàgazze who turns out to be Will's lost father John Parry; both die telling Will he must take the Knife to Asriel.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills two long-standing allies and gives Will his marching orders for season 3.

beats.label: S2 · Coulter takes Lyra
beats.text: Angels flock to Asriel for the coming war and Mary crosses into Cittàgazze as the prophesied 'Serpent'; Coulter abducts a drugged Lyra and vanishes with her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The exact situation season 3 opens on: Lyra captive, Will separated, war massing.

cliffhanger.text: Coulter has vanished with a drugged Lyra, and Will has the Subtle Knife but no idea where either of them are. Asriel is gathering angels and armies for open war against the Authority, and Cardinal MacPhail now knows Lyra is prophesied to bring a new Fall.
questions: Where has Coulter taken Lyra, and what does she intend to do with her?
Will Will deliver the Knife to Asriel, or use it to find Lyra first?
How will the Magisterium try to stop the second Eve before she falls?

characters.name: Lyra Belacqua
characters.line: Drugged and imprisoned by her own mother, cut off from Will and separated from the war she was pulled into.

characters.name: Will Parry
characters.line: Newly the bearer of the Subtle Knife, orphaned by his father's death, alone in Cittàgazze and searching for Lyra.

characters.name: Mrs Marisa Coulter
characters.line: Has captured Lyra and knows she is prophesied as the second Eve; both her mother and her jailer, hiding from the Magisterium.

characters.name: Lord Asriel
characters.line: Rallying angels and rebel armies in another world for open war against the Authority; still ignorant that Lyra has been taken.

characters.name: Mary Malone
characters.line: Oxford physicist who studied Dust in secret; the angels named her the 'Serpent' and sent her through into Cittàgazze on a mission she does not yet understand.

characters.name: Cardinal MacPhail
characters.line: Newly elected head of the Magisterium after his rival's arrest; regards Lyra's death as necessary to prevent a second Fall.

characters.name: Serafina Pekkala
characters.line: Witch queen still fighting alongside the rebels; last seen defending Will and Lyra and healing his mutilated hand.

beats.label: S3 · The hidden child
beats.text: Coulter drugs Lyra and hides her on a remote island; MacPhail dispatches assassin Father Gomez to kill the second Eve; Asriel recruits Commander Ogunwe's rebels.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets all three factions moving toward Lyra at once and names the players in the coming war.

beats.label: S3 · Will rescues Lyra
beats.text: Two rebel angels press Will to bring the Knife to Asriel, but he finds Lyra first; the Knife shatters on Coulter's face and Iorek later mends it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reunites the protagonists and re-forges the object every plan depends on.

beats.label: S3 · Down to the dead
beats.text: Haunted by dreams of Roger, Lyra insists on descending into the Land of the Dead; she and Will leave their daemons behind on the shore to cross the water.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The separation from their daemons is the central wound of the season's second half.

beats.label: S3 · Mary among the Mulefa
beats.text: Mary reaches the Mulefa's world and sees Dust bleeding out of every universe; Coulter escapes Asriel's camp and returns to MacPhail feigning loyalty.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the disease afflicting all worlds and puts Coulter back inside the Magisterium at its most dangerous.

beats.label: S3 · The bomb
beats.text: MacPhail builds a bomb keyed to a lock of Lyra's hair; it detonates but she survives, then persuades the Harpies to let all the dead escape into the sky.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills MacPhail and empties the Land of the Dead, freeing Lyra for the final battle.

beats.label: S3 · Death of the Authority
beats.text: At the Clouded Mountain, Asriel and Coulter drag the regent Metatron into an abyss and die with him; the ancient Authority himself dissolves in the wind.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The war's outcome and the deaths of both her parents in a single act.

beats.label: S3 · Two Oxfords, one bench
beats.text: Will and Lyra fall in love, restoring Dust to every world; but the windows between worlds must all close, so they part forever, one bench in each Oxford.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The show's final state — every character sorted, the two leads separated by physics.

cliffhanger.text: The war is won and the Authority is dead, but the Subtle Knife is broken and every window between worlds is sealed. Lyra is back in Jordan College and Will back with his mother, each sworn to sit alone in their own Oxford Botanic Garden every midsummer's day, unable ever to cross to the other.
questions: Can Lyra learn to read the alethiometer again now that her intuitive gift has left her?
What does a Republic of Heaven built by mortals look like without the Authority above it?
Will the two of them keep their midsummer promise across the decades ahead?

characters.name: Lyra Belacqua
characters.line: Back at Jordan College without Will; the intuitive reading of the alethiometer has left her and she must learn it the slow way.

characters.name: Will Parry
characters.line: Returned to his Oxford and reunited with his mother; broke the Subtle Knife himself so the openings could be sealed for good.

characters.name: Mrs Marisa Coulter
characters.line: Dead. Sacrificed herself alongside Asriel to drag the regent Metatron into the abyss.

characters.name: Lord Asriel
characters.line: Dead. Died with Coulter in the fall that killed Metatron and effectively ended the war he had spent his life preparing for.

characters.name: Mary Malone
characters.line: Returned to her own Oxford after playing the Serpent for the Mulefa; can now see her own daemon.

characters.name: Cardinal MacPhail
characters.line: Dead. Killed when his own bomb detonated after trying to sever Coulter from her daemon to power it.

characters.name: Serafina Pekkala
characters.line: The witch queen who found the lost daemons and reunited them with Will and Lyra before the parting.

characters.name: Iorek Byrnison
characters.line: Bear king who agreed to mend the Subtle Knife for the descent into the Land of the Dead.
